name: boss64
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create an animation sprite sheet of EXACTLY 64 chronological distinct drawings in an EXACT 8 columns by 8 rows uniform square grid, read left to right then next row. 2048x2048 preferred. All cells equal size, genuine transparent background, NO grid, no text. Reference is the identity of the same golden lion boss: chestnut mane, white rolled sleeve shirt, dark teal waistcoat, burgundy tie, golden paws, tail. CRITICAL: EVERY frame is REAR VIEW, the camera sees his BACK, BACK OF MANE and BACK OF WAISTCOAT. He faces away from the viewer, turned a little toward the RIGHT toward an unseen employee. No front view, no visible face or eyes, no side-on face. Keep the character centered at a fixed anchor with feet on the same baseline in all cells. Full body and entire pointing arm inside EACH cell, generous margins, same scale, clean isolated silhouette. Polished hand drawn 2D animation with expressive subtle weight shifts, smooth anticipation and follow through. Chronology: row1 and row2 (frames1-16): confident short walking cycle seen from behind, moving in place with alternating feet, tail swaying, finishes stopping. Rows3,4,5 (frames17-40): both hands firmly on hips, stern boss stance facing his employee on his right, subtle breathing, head tilt and small scolding gestures of shoulders while hands remain on hips, tail swishes. Row6 (frames41-48): anticipates pointing, lifts right arm smoothly off hip. Rows7,8 (frames49-64): extends right arm and index finger clearly toward RIGHT edge, left hand stays on hip, firm reprimand, settles into sustained pointing pose. This is one coherent animation, NOT random unrelated poses. No employee, no desk, no computer, no props, no speech bubbles, no scene/background/floor, no labels, no watermark. Consistent identity, clothing, proportions and rendering throughout.

name: reaction-ratel
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one animation sprite sheet, EXACTLY 16 chronological frames in an EXACT uniform 4 columns by 4 rows grid, 2048x2048 preferred, genuinely transparent background, no grid or labels. Reference image supplies the exact character identity and illustration style. Subject: same a honey badger, slate gray fur, cream white stripe and mane from head to tail, olive green eyes, no clothes. Match reference absolutely, no redesign. Clean hand drawn 2D adventure cartoon with consistent face, clothing, proportions, full body and fixed size and anchor. Employee has just been reprimanded by the boss standing to the employee's LEFT. ONE character per cell, no other characters. Chronology read left to right then next row. First row frames1-4: surprised by a reprimand from LEFT, eyes widen, ears and shoulders jump, hands lift, head turns LEFT, worried/comically guilty expression. Second row frames5-8: startled recovery, glance LEFT at boss, quickly lean forward and return paws to keyboard height. Third and fourth rows frames9-16: nervous FAST typing cycle with alternating paws, hunched shoulders, tense wide eyes looking down and occasional anxious glance LEFT, subtle shaking and busy body, loopable typing poses, NOT a calm smiling employee. Render ONLY the animal, NO furniture and NO keyboard/computer/laptop/desk/chair: these are separate fixed layers in the application. The hands type in the air at a shared keyboard height around 67% of each cell. Feet on a common baseline at 94% height, full body visible, comfortable transparent margins, same camera 3/4 front view in all frames, tail intact. Same scale and placement throughout, gradual sequential movement. No background, no floor, no text, no speech bubbles, no motion lines, no effects, no logos.
